cohort: 100 women aged 18-45 years with singleton pregnancies (37-41 weeks gestational age) undergoing repeat cesarean sections.
finding: Electrocautery incision for repeat cesarean sections resulted in significantly shorter operative time, less blood loss, and less post-operative pain compared to scalpel incision.
mod_finding: Electrocautery was found to be a better technique than scalpel for abdominal incisions during repeat caesarian sections, leading to reduced operative time, blood loss, and post-operative pain.
